versions.changelog: Initial public release - Gentle reminders to stay human while using AI

Agency Guardian 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Introduces weekly reflection questions to encourage independent thinking.
- Adds gentle boundary nudges for sensitive topics (health, finance, relationships) as optional reminders.
- Occasionally shares brief quotes about staying human while using AI.
- Prioritizes user agency and awareness—no restrictive features, just reflection and context.
- Configurable options allow users to customize reminders and nudges.
